Title: [LSJ] Rules Q: Slave vampire using Clan Impersonation to become ruling clan

Messages.Author: Hardy Range
Messages.Body:
Hello,

although I did some searching on Google, I haven't found a message
which makes this absolutely clear to me:

If I control a "Slave" vampire (e.g., a Camarilla Tremer Slave
Gargoyle), andn that vampire uses Clan Impersonation to become a
member of the required rulinf clan (on teh example, CI to a Tremere) -
is the requirement fulfilled, so that the Slave vamp may take direct
actions?

In other words: Can a vampire be both the slave and the member of the
ruling clan?

Regards,

Hardy Range
